basics.summary: Theoretical and computational astrophysicist working at the interface of cosmology, galaxy formation and evolution. I study the co-evolution of supermassive black holes, galaxies and dark matter halos with cosmological hydrodynamic simulations, and develop statistical measures that connect simulation predictions to galaxy-survey observations.

work.name: Presidency University, Kolkata
work.position: PhD Research Scholar, School of Astrophysics
work.summary: Advisor: Dr. Suchetana Chatterjee. Thesis (tentative): Large Scale Structures in the High Redshift Universe.
highlights: Studying the co-evolution of supermassive black holes and dark matter halos in cosmological hydrodynamic simulations (IllustrisTNG, SIMBA).
Quantifying the AGN–halo connection with halo occupation distribution (HOD) and conditional luminosity function (CLF) frameworks.
Developing a joint statistical framework combining luminosity functions and two-point correlation functions to constrain the AGN–halo connection and reconstruct quasar host halo properties.
